line_objective: Represent a mechanism-first AI LAB line for pre-move anomaly confidence before expansion without changing runtime, live truth, or winner state.

pre_move_compression_release_quality.mechanism_focus: Differentiate clean compression-release setups from noisy low-volatility pauses before expansion confirmation.
pre_move_compression_release_quality.known_baseline_weakness: Baseline can react only once expansion is already visible and may treat weak compressions too similarly to strong pre-release structures.
pre_move_compression_release_quality.expected_edge_path: Improve early quality separation before expansion and reduce weak pre-move entries.

micro_acceleration_before_expansion.mechanism_focus: Measure micro-acceleration build before visible expansion to separate genuine launch preparation from flat drift.
micro_acceleration_before_expansion.known_baseline_weakness: Baseline may wait for visible expansion and miss whether directional pressure was already accelerating in the bars immediately before breakout.
micro_acceleration_before_expansion.expected_edge_path: Capture stronger pre-expansion intent while avoiding delayed confirmation on already obvious moves.

participation_divergence_instability_fil.mechanism_focus: Filter pre-move setups when participation and internal stability diverge from apparent price readiness.
participation_divergence_instability_fil.known_baseline_weakness: Baseline can read surface readiness while missing unstable participation or divergence that makes pre-move setups fragile.
participation_divergence_instability_fil.expected_edge_path: Reduce fragile pre-move approvals by vetoing setups with unstable participation structure.

allowed_scope: mechanism-first pre-move confidence hypotheses before visible expansion
new pre-expansion state classification or veto logic derived from deterministic market structure evidence
contract-only family specs and human-seeded batch registration inside research_os
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: source_of_truth writes or official truth mutation
APP DATA EXECUTION file changes or runtime behavior changes
live-order canary dry-run bridge or execution intent logic
broad random search unbounded parameter sweeps or generic threshold tuning
winner promotion live truth rewiring or any production handoff
